verdicts.reason: Text explicitly says the stage "MUST NOT: ... modify `spec.md` or `plan.md` in any way".
The same "MUST NOT ... modify `spec.md` or `plan.md` in any way" applies to round 2 of the converge stage.
"The stage's **only** writes are its round report" limits writes rather than requiring a round-2 report to exist, so it supports existence only implicitly (g5.cv-050.0 covers it directly).
The stage's write is defined as "appending a new `## Phase N: Convergence` section to `tasks.md`", which directly supports the convergence-phase check.
The text bans only "modify, create, or delete any application code", while a blanket repo_write ban is stricter because it would also catch the allowed report and tasks.md writes.
Same as round 1: only "any application code" is banned, so a general repo_write prohibition goes beyond the text.
"the stage MUST leave `tasks.md` **byte-for-byte unchanged** (no empty Convergence header)" directly supports the append-only/unchanged check.
The same "MUST leave `tasks.md` **byte-for-byte unchanged**" rule applies to round 2.
"and record a clean result in its round report" supports a converged-line check, and should is an appropriate level.
"record a clean result in its round report" applies equally to convergence-2.
The text says to "Run `.../check-prerequisites.sh --json --require-spec --require-tasks --include-tasks` once" with exactly these arguments.
The same "Run ... check-prerequisites.sh --json --require-spec --require-tasks --include-tasks once" applies to the round-2 window.
Borderline: "Task IDs (to compute the next ID and next phase number)" only implies that convergence lines continue the ID/phase sequence, but the item is already a should.
"Classify every finding by **gap type**" with the listed missing/partial/contradicts/unrequested values supports the findings check.
"Classify every finding by **gap type**" applies to the round-2 report as well.
"**Nothing remains**: produce zero findings and follow the converged branch" supports the outcome-rows check at should level.
The same "produce zero findings and follow the converged branch" applies to convergence-2.
"### 5. Assign Severity ... CRITICAL ... HIGH ... MEDIUM ... LOW" requires every finding to carry a severity.
The text names the output as "`FEATURE_DIR/convergence.md` in round 1", which supports the existence check.
The text names the output as "`FEATURE_DIR/convergence-2.md` in round 2", which supports the existence check.
